name: PluckCols
description: Keep only the columns matching any of the provided selectors (whitelist by column name).
usage: Provide at least one of ``columns`` (exact names), ``pattern`` (glob), ``regex``, ``startswith`` or ``endswith``. Matches from every selector are unioned and returned in the original column order. An exact name in ``columns`` that is not present raises an error.

attributes.name: columns
attributes.description: Exact column names to keep. Raises if a named column is not present.

attributes.name: pattern
attributes.description: Glob/fnmatch pattern to match column names (e.g. "revenue_*").

attributes.name: regex
attributes.description: Regular expression to match column names (e.g. "^(name|email)$").

attributes.name: startswith
attributes.description: Keep columns whose name starts with any of these prefixes.

attributes.name: endswith
attributes.description: Keep columns whose name ends with any of these suffixes.

json_schema.title: PluckCols

pattern.description: Glob/fnmatch pattern to match column names (e.g. "revenue_*").

regex.description: Regular expression to match column names (e.g. "^(name|email)$").

startswith.description: Prefixes; columns starting with any are kept.

endswith.description: Suffixes; columns ending with any are kept.

json_schema.description: Keep columns matching any selector. At least one selector is required.
